note: Screening guidance, not a confirmed diagnosis. Confirm with local agronomic advice before treatment.

healthy.title: No supported disease detected
healthy.check: The model only screens four conditions; this result does not rule out other diseases, pests or nutrient problems.
healthy.action: Keep a dated photo and observe changes. If visible damage persists, photograph the whole plant and ask a local crop adviser.

common_rust.title: Suspected common rust
common_rust.check: Check both leaf surfaces for raised rust-colored to dark brown pustules.
common_rust.action: Photograph both surfaces and compare nearby plants. Record crop stage and affected leaf positions before seeking confirmation.

gray_leaf_spot.title: Suspected gray leaf spot
gray_leaf_spot.check: Look for narrow rectangular tan-to-gray lesions bounded by leaf veins.
gray_leaf_spot.action: Capture lesions with visible veins and a whole-plant view. Check several plants; similar leaf spots need confirmation.

northern_leaf_blight.title: Suspected northern leaf blight
northern_leaf_blight.check: Look for long, elliptical or cigar-shaped tan-to-gray lesions.
northern_leaf_blight.action: Photograph the full lesion and its edges, plus the whole plant. Record whether symptoms occur on nearby plants and seek confirmation.

non_target.title: Corn leaf not confirmed
non_target.check: This score does not establish that corn is absent, or that the camera is too far away.
non_target.action: Try one corn leaf filling most of the view, reduce background, keep it in focus and avoid screen glare.

uncertain.title: Unable to judge reliably
uncertain.check: The supported classes are not sufficiently separated in this frame.
uncertain.action: Hold still, use even light and take a clear close-up of one leaf. If results disagree, save photos for review rather than choosing a disease.

waiting.title: Hold steady
waiting.check: Waiting for three consecutive matching accepted predictions.
waiting.action: Keep the same leaf in view. This consistency check reduces flicker; it does not prove a diagnosis.
